description: This Java source file defines the ParameterCrossReference class, which maintains a map of Parameter objects to their corresponding string descriptions related to vehicle parameters such as battery, intake air temperature, and fuel ratio. It includes methods to retrieve these descriptions based on Parameter keys.

classes.name: ParameterCrossReference
classes.description: A class that maps specific Parameter objects to their string descriptions relevant to vehicle parameters.

methods.name: ParameterCrossReference
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map with predefined Parameter-to-string mappings.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string description associated with a given Parameter key.
